name: the-drive-ai
description: Find, read, organize and share the documents in your The Drive AI workspace from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
The Drive AI is an AI-native document workspace. This app connects ChatGPT to your own The Drive AI account, with your own permissions, so you can work with your files without leaving the conversation.

Find anything: browse folders, find files by name, type, size or date, search documents by what they are about, or find an exact phrase inside them. Google Drive, OneDrive, SharePoint and Dropbox folders you have connected to The Drive AI appear as folders too.

Read and answer: read the pages of a PDF or the sheets of a spreadsheet, and ask questions about what they say.

Organize safely: every change (moving, renaming, creating folders, writing a document) is proposed first as a preview of exactly what will happen. Bigger or destructive changes wait for your confirmation, and any applied change can be undone.

Save files: save a file you give ChatGPT, or a file from a public link, into any folder.

Share: see who can reach a file or folder, and share or revoke access, always after asking you first.

Sign in with your The Drive AI account. ChatGPT only ever sees what you can see.
capabilities: Search documents by meaning or exact text
Move, rename and organize files with a preview and undo
Save attachments and links into folders
defaultPrompt: What's in my Drive AI workspace?
Find my most recent invoices in The Drive AI
Summarize the documents in my Contracts folder

positive.prompt: What's in my The Drive AI workspace? Give me a quick overview of the main folders.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the signed-in account's workspace and lists the top-level folders of the demo workspace (for example /Finance, /Contracts, /Projects) with a short description of each. Makes no changes.

positive.description: Search by meaning and read the result
positive.prompt: Find the vendor contract in The Drive AI that mentions a termination notice period and tell me how many days notice is required.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the matching contract in /Contracts, reads it, and answers with the notice period stated in the document, citing the file's path.

positive.description: Find files by type and date
positive.prompt: List the PDF invoices in my Finance folder from 2025 in The Drive AI.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the PDF files under /Finance whose dates fall in 2025, with names and paths. Makes no changes.

positive.description: Organize files with a preview, then apply
positive.prompt: In The Drive AI, create a folder called /Finance/2025 Invoices and move the 2025 invoice PDFs into it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the 2025 invoices, proposes a changeset that creates the folder and moves those files, shows the preview (counts and file names), and applies it. If the server asks for confirmation, ChatGPT asks the user before applying. Reports the result and that it can be undone.

positive.description: Save a document written in the conversation
positive.prompt: Write a one-page meeting notes template and save it to /Projects in The Drive AI as Meeting Notes Template.
positive.expected_behavior: Writes the template, saves it as a new document in /Projects through a changeset, and replies with the saved document's path.

negative.description: General question unrelated to the person's files
A different cloud storage product the user names explicitly
negative.prompt: Open my iCloud Drive and list the photos from last week.

negative.description: General writing with no request to save or use workspace files
negative.prompt: Write me a short poem about autumn.

publication.release_notes: First release of The Drive AI for ChatGPT: browse, search and read your documents, organize them with previewed and undoable changes, save files into folders, and manage sharing, all as the signed-in person.
